what: SOFTMAX-T (2026-10-23): the exponential's single scaling and the softmaxes in one pass, every value as it was -- on the AVX-512 instance the BCIR exponential applies 2^k by one vscalefps (exp1's two power-of-two scalings round once, the first exact, as vscalefps rounds once), its exponential, SiLU, SiLU times u and SwiGLU VJP run as AVX-512 instances, four vectors' chains a step at a time; the scratch forward's lanes softmax and the stored forward's transposed blocks scale, subtract, exponentiate, mask and sum in one pass; and the lanes path divides each key's probabilities inside the context's first pass, once, before the context reads them. Measured on the committed tree against the tree before it: the cross-build hashes, the exponential and the SiLU forms over every binary32 (against their scalar definitions, and before against after), the attention forward with both units in one process beside an A/A control, bcir_decoder_forward and the training step in one process, and the GEO study's attention model's inference and training update built as the study builds it, against PyTorch; and the design runs: v1 and v2 of the prototype, a level at a time, with the lanes path's phases.
